summary:
Palantir EPS超預期8.6%，季度營收逾14億美元顯示AI平台需求持續攀升。
• EPS 0.25美元，超出預期0.23美元，超預期幅度8.60%
• 營收14.1億美元，反映AIP平台商業需求持續攀升
• 商業客戶擴張帶動營收結構優化
• 獲利穩定超預期，顯示規模化獲利能力改善
ai_view:
訊號偏強：EPS超預期8.6%顯示Palantir獲利能力穩步改善，AIP平台商業需求持續攀升。短期對股價偏多，惟營收年增率未揭露，須結合次季85%高成長佐證動能。中期核心在商業客戶擴張與淨擴張率。追蹤指標：商業營收年增、客戶數、NRR、營業利潤率、自由現金流與全年指引，並留意149倍高估值的支撑性。

需留意：營收年增率未揭露，惟下一季顯示高速成長；149倍本益比對成長放緩極度敏感；政府合約集中與AI題材波動的估值風險

summary_en:
Palantir beat EPS by 8.6% with $1.41B revenue, showing AI-platform demand keeps climbing.
• EPS of $0.25 beat the $0.23 estimate by 8.60%
• Revenue of $1.41B reflects rising AIP-platform commercial demand
• Commercial-customer expansion improves the revenue mix
• A steady earnings beat shows improving profitability at scale

ai_view_en:
Signal is firm: an 8.6% EPS beat shows Palantir's profitability steadily improving as AIP commercial demand climbs. Near-term bullish, though with YoY undisclosed, momentum should be cross-checked against the next quarter's 85% growth. Mid-term the core is commercial-customer expansion and net retention. Track: commercial revenue growth, customer count, NRR, operating margin, free cash flow and full-year guidance, while watching support for the 149x multiple.

Watch：Revenue YoY not disclosed, though the next quarter shows high growth; A 149x P/E is hypersensitive to any growth slowdown; Valuation risk from government-contract concentration and AI-theme volatility
beat_or_miss: 超預期 / EPS超預期8.60%，獲利優於預估（營收年增率未揭露）。
